title: How CO₂ absorbs infrared
caption: Earth radiates infrared. CO₂ molecules absorb photons of about 15 μm, which match the energy of their bending vibration (8.0 kJ mol⁻¹ per photon mole), and re-emit it in all directions, some back down: the greenhouse effect.
alt: Vibrational levels of CO₂'s bending mode, v = 0 and v = 1, with an upward arrow for absorption of 15 μm infrared.
description: Absorption of a 15 μm photon, 8.0 kJ mol⁻¹.
